title: Do three steps while keeping the task list
prompt:
Do these in order, and keep a task list while you work (one item in progress at a time, each marked completed when it is done):
1. Create a.txt containing the word alpha.
2. Create b.txt containing the word beta.
3. Create c.txt containing the word gamma.
check: grep -q '^alpha$' a.txt && grep -q '^beta$' b.txt && grep -q '^gamma$' c.txt
